plainTranslation: Dreamy, romantic, almost unreal. You see each other as perfect. Gorgeous and blind in spots. Watch deception, on either side. Love the real person, not the screen you put up.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
